decisions.statement: A list names the records kept beside this agent's page for the subagents under it.
The edits this agent keeps of its own are named by another command.
A record is named with the subagent that left it, the time the seat took it, and what it does.
A record saying no subagent or no time is named as saying none.
An edit is said the way every act over the edits kept says an edit.
The records are named in the order the seat took them rather than in the order a name sorts.
A record is numbered by its place in what the seat keeps.
A list names the call reading one record whole and the call taking one away.
A list says whether a record it names landed already is undecidable.
A list names the call taking a record into the edits this agent keeps.
A word on the command line other than the help flag is refused.
A flag other than the help flag is refused as any other word is.
The help flag is answered with what a list names and what a list takes.
An agent keeping no record is said rather than refused.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
A list takes nothing piped in.
The help flag reaches this command's own help rather than the namespace's.

definition: the command naming the records a seat keeps for the subagents under it
